assignment: impl-21.sh, independent — Obsidian-CLI vault verification (ledger-backed moved-to-obsidian)
what_it_does: Ledger-backed moved-to-obsidian receipts with strict hash semantics (both columns required, recomputed on both sides; hex case-folded), hazard guards (self-move / symlink-alias / nested vault / relative-row rejection), first-full-match row wins, and an advisory --cli layer: bounded timeout, launcher content guard, post-CLI re-read against TOCTOU, disagreement recorded while local hashes decide. Emits the r2 VERDICT line plus the r4 VERIFIED/NOT-VERIFIED(reason) line.
